spans.s:
तृतीय a. The third.
--यं A third
part.
--Comp.
--प्रकृतिः m. or f. {1} a
eunuch. {2} the neuter gender.

1 The third day of a lunar
fortnight.
--2 (In gram.) The
instrumental case or its terminations.
[]
--Comp.
--कृत a. thrice ploughed
(as a field).
--तत्पुरुषः the
instrumental Tatpuruṣa.
--प्रकृतिः m., f.
{1} a cunuch. {2} a hermaphrodite.
{3} the neuter gender.

तृतीयक a.
1 Recurring every
third day, tertian (as a fever).
--2
Occurring for the third time.
--3 The
third.

तृतीयिन् a.
1 Entitled to a third
portion (of inheritance &c.).
--2
Occupying the third rank.
